name: zone_offset_milliseconds
description: zone_offset written in milliseconds (7200000) instead of seconds (7200). HC rejects the entire import with java.time.DateTimeException.

name: record_at_cutoff_timestamp
description: A steps record whose start_time equals the cutoff timestamp (2026-03-18T00:00:00Z). Invariant test: records must be strictly before cutoff.

name: record_after_cutoff
description: A weight record with a timestamp 1 day after the cutoff. Builder must filter these out.

name: duplicate_uuid
description: Two weight records with the same uuid. HC UNIQUE constraint on uuid would reject the second insert.

name: duplicate_dedupe_hash
description: Two weight records with identical (app_info_id, device_info_id, time) → identical dedupe_hash. HC UNIQUE on dedupe_hash would reject the second.

name: write_to_change_logs_table
description: Attempt to insert a row into change_logs_table (DO_NOT_TOUCH). WriteGuard must raise ProtectedTableError.

name: write_to_local_date_time_column
description: Attempt to write to the generated column local_date_time. WriteGuard must raise ProtectedTableError.

name: negative_zone_offset_out_of_range
description: zone_offset of -72000 (outside ±64800 range). HC would reject with DateTimeException.
